title: Beatrix and the Hollow
author: Vesper Amberdale
blurb: Felix Okonkwo, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
